mentions.name: Nonoverse
mentions.description: A nonogram puzzle game featuring generated puzzles organized into distinct level styles, described as being a bit like Minecraft biomes. Includes a released small-but-difficult low density set, with larger puzzles in progress.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Generating nonogram puzzles that are fun to solve. I define different level styles, a bit like minecraft biomes.

I just released a small-but-difficult low density set which I like a lot. I’m starting work on larger puzzles (second or third attempt).

Screens and download: https://lab174.com/nonoverse/
mentions.author: merelysounds
